theater: 阿爾及利亞沿海與卡比利亞山區

battle.name: 阿爾及利亞戰爭
battle.theater: 阿爾及利亞沿海與卡比利亞山區
battle.brief: 一九五四年十一月一日深夜，解放陣線在三十餘座城鎮同時開火，獨立戰爭打了七年八個月；法軍以海岸封鎖與清剿應戰，一九六二年三月《埃維昂協議》簽訂，七月五日建國。卡面這艘一八六二年英國鐵甲艦並未參戰，它標示的是法國靠海軍撐起的那片鹹海，解放陣線海上有生力量曾以水雷擊沉法軍巡洋艦。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries:
交戰雙方是法國與阿爾及利亞民族解放陣線，但每一方內部都另有一場戰爭在並行。

法國一方以法屬阿爾及利亞為戰場。行政上，阿爾及利亞自一八三〇年代起被劃為法國本土的三個省，由總督主政；軍事上隸屬法國陸軍阿爾及利亞部隊，統一由阿爾及爾的軍區司令部與本土後方指揮。駐軍包括外國軍團第一、第二、第三團（第三團即乍得行軍團）、北非土著步兵與斯帕希騎兵、殖民地步兵，以及第十一空降突擊旅這類精銳部隊；兵源除常備軍外，還有每年一批從本土輪替而來的徵召兵。輔助軍力包括共和警衛、國家保安兵團、一九五五年成立的軍事情報局（DGSE），以及由北非土著士兵組成、直接聽命於法國指揮官的哈基斯輔助部隊。海上由阿爾及爾海軍司令部負責，巡防艦、驅逐艦、掃雷艦與航空母艦上的第六飛行中隊組成封住海岸的一道牆。

解放陣線一方是一九五四年成立的政軍合一組織。最高權力是三十四人組成的全國革命委員會，執行層是五人的協調與執行委員會；組織分為在阿爾及利亞境內作戰的內部派，以及駐摩洛哥、突尼西亞的外部派；武裝力量是民族解放軍，設北部軍區、南方軍區、海上支隊與負責政治工作的特別組織。外部支援來自摩洛哥與突尼西亞，武器經烏季達與突尼斯轉運入山。第三方包括一九五五年從解放陣線分裂出去的穆沙德運動、阿爾及利亞共產黨的武裝組織（解散後其武器大量流入解放陣線），以及一九六一年起在法國本土策動武裝叛亂、拒絕《埃維昂協議》的反獨立秘密軍組織。
countriesEn:
The two belligerents were France and the Algerian National Liberation Front, but each of them was fighting a second war inside its own camp.

On the French side the battlefield was French Algeria. Administratively, from the 1830s Algeria had been constituted as three departments of metropolitan France, governed by a governor-general; militarily it belonged to the French Army in Algeria, commanded from the army corps headquarters at Algiers together with the metropolitan high command. The garrison included the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Foreign Infantry Regiments (the 3rd being the Chasseurs d'Afrique regiment known as the Régiment de Marche du Tchad), North African Tirailleurs and Spahis, colonial infantry, and elite airborne units such as the 11th Parachute Choc Brigade; beyond the regular army, fresh conscripts were rotated out of metropolitan France every year. The auxiliary forces included the Garde Républicaine, the CRS riot police, the military intelligence service (DGSE) created in 1955, and the Harkis auxiliaries, North African soldiers who served directly under French commanders. At sea the naval command at Algiers provided the wall that sealed the coast, with sloops, destroyers, minesweepers and the sixth air group flying from aircraft carriers.

On the FLN side was a political-military organisation founded in 1954. The highest authority was the National Council of the Algerian Revolution with thirty-four members, and the executive was the five-man Committee of Coordination and Execution; the organisation was divided between the internals fighting inside Algeria and the externals based in Morocco and Tunisia; its armed force was the National Liberation Army, with northern and southern military regions, a naval arm and a Special Organisation handling political work. External support came from Morocco and Tunisia, and weapons were moved in through Oujda and Tunis into the mountains. Third parties included the Mouvement National Algérien, which split away from the FLN in 1955, the armed organisation of the Algerian Communist Party, whose weapons flooded into the FLN after it was dissolved, and the anti-independence secret army organisation that from 1961 waged armed rebellion in metropolitan France against the Evian Accords.
people:
法國一方的關鍵人物集中在三種身分：接管阿爾及利亞的將軍、策動兵變的將軍，以及最終決定放棄法國阿爾及利亞的元首。雅克·蘇斯泰爾一九五五年出任總督，主張同化，把這片土地當作法國本土來經營；羅伯·拉科斯特一九五六年以政府代表兼情報總局局長的身分接管，先後逮捕解放陣線外部派領袖，又主持了情報機關的整肅，情報機構從此直接介入阿爾及利亞的日常鎮壓。雅克·馬蘇將軍一九五八年以阿爾及爾軍事指揮官兼總督的身分主持五月十三日兵變，要求由軍人接管政權；兵變失敗後，他捲入一九六一年反對協議的武裝政變。戴高樂一九五八年六月重返法國，設立第五共和國並推行阿爾及利亞自決政策，最終在一九六二年三月批准協議。空降突擊營指揮官羅傑·比吉爾以手段狠辣著稱，一九五七年被軍事法庭判處四年監禁，一九六二年獲赦。

解放陣線一方最重要的名字都在小組裏。艾哈邁德·本·貝拉與穆罕默德·布迪亞夫一九五六年十月在從摩洛哥飛往突尼斯的客機上被法方劫回阿爾及爾，囚禁至一九六二年；哈德·艾哈邁德、拉爾比·本·邁迪迪、穆罕默德·基德爾構成了外部派的政治核心，基德爾更於一九六一年在法蘭克福遇刺。城市游擊的核心是哈西巴·本·布阿里與雅西夫·齊古德，前者一九五七年十二月在阿爾及爾戰役中陣亡，後者於一九五六年陣亡；賈米拉·布希列德早在一九五五年就策劃了蒙彼利埃火藥庫爆炸案。費爾哈特·阿巴斯以《阿爾及利亞人民宣言》為阿爾及利亞民族主義奠基，一九五六年加入解放陣線。戰後的餘波仍留在人物身上：一九九二年布迪亞夫當選總統，隨即遇刺身亡。
peopleEn:
The key French figures fall into three kinds: the general who took charge of Algeria, the general who staged a coup, and the head of state who finally let go of French Algeria. Jacques Soustelle became governor-general in 1955 and pursued integration, treating the country as a piece of metropolitan France; Robert Lacoste took over in 1956 as both the government's representative and the head of the intelligence service, arresting the external FLN leadership and presiding over a purge of the intelligence services, after which the secret service took a direct part in the day-to-day repression in Algeria. General Jacques Massu, in 1958 both the military commander of Algiers and governor-general, led the coup of 13 May, demanding that the generals take over the government; after the failure of the putsch he was drawn into the armed revolt of 1961 against the accords. De Gaulle returned to France in June 1958, set up the Fifth Republic and pursued a policy of self-determination for Algeria, and in March 1962 he approved the agreements. Roger Bigeard, commander of the airborne shock battalions, was known for his ruthlessness; a military tribunal sentenced him in 1957 and he was pardoned in 1962.

On the FLN side the most important names all came out of the small cells. Ahmed Ben Bella and Mohamed Boudiaf were carried back to Algiers by the French in October 1956 when a flight from Morocco to Tunis was intercepted, and they stayed in prison until 1962; Hocine Aït Ahmed, Larbi Ben M'hidi and Mohamed Khider formed the political core of the external delegation, and Khider was assassinated in Frankfurt in 1961. The core of the urban guerrilla were Hassiba Ben Bouali and Yacef Zighoud, the former killed in the fighting in Algiers in December 1957 and the latter in 1956; Djamila Bouhired was already planning the attack on the gunpowder factory at Montpellier in 1955. Ferhat Abbas laid the foundations of Algerian nationalism with the Manifesto of the Algerian People and joined the FLN in 1956. The aftershocks of the war remained in the lives of these people: in 1992 Boudiaf was elected president and was assassinated shortly afterwards.
kits:
卡面上這艘一八六二年前後的英國鐵甲艦並沒有出現在阿爾及利亞，它代表的是同一場戰爭裡早已退場的那一代海軍技術。一八六〇年前後英國的戰士號、防禦號、黑王子號、復仇號相繼下水：木殼外面包上一條約四吋半的鐵甲帶，排水量約九千噸，縱列排布十門八吋與十六門六吋三的前裝火砲，靠浮動砲塔把火砲收進裝甲堡裡。到一九五四年，這條技術路線早被全重裝主力艦取代：英國在一九〇六年有了無畏號，法國海軍手上的裝甲巡洋艦是阿爾及利亞級，主砲是五五公厘；一九五五年服役的讓·巴爾特號是法國最後一艘主力艦，滿載排水約四萬噸，配兩座三聯裝三八〇公厘砲塔。

但海軍在這場戰爭裡並非可有可無。法國海軍在地中海拉起一道沿海岸的封鎖線，巡防艦與驅逐艦日夜巡邏，掃雷艇清除解放陣線布設的水雷，護航隊攔截從摩洛哥運來的武器，一九五六年更在摩洛哥沿岸大範圍布雷，切斷北非的海上運輸線；一九五八年九月，軍艦曾以艦砲砲擊卡比利亞沿岸一帶。解放陣線也組建了海上支隊，一九五八年十二月八日以水雷擊沉泊在阿爾比港的法國輕巡洋艦喬治·菲利帕爾號。

真正決定地面戰的仍是步兵裝備：法軍用MAS-49半自動步槍（7.5×54公厘，彈匣十發）與MAS-36手槍（9×19公厘），配十二點七公厘熱維什機槍與一〇五公厘榴砲；解放陣線方面，一九五六年之後從捷克斯洛伐克、中國與埃及運來的AK-47（7.62×39公厘，彈匣三十發）與繳獲的法軍步槍組成主力，另有法製AMX-13裝甲車、Sherman戰車、暴風式螺旋槳戰鬥機，以及一九五五年起投入使用的Alouette直昇機。
kitsEn:
The ironclad on the card never appeared in Algeria; what it represents is a generation of naval technology that had already left the stage of the very war in question. Around 1860 the British ships Warrior, Defence, Black Prince and Revenge entered service: a wooden hull wrapped in an iron belt about four and a half inches thick, a displacement of roughly nine thousand tons, ten eight-inch and sixteen six-point-three-inch muzzle-loading guns ranged in a broadside, and the guns worked into turrets behind the armour. By 1954 this line of development had long been superseded by the all-big-gun capital ship: Britain had Dreadnought from 1906, the French navy's armoured cruisers were the Algérie class with 155-millimetre guns, and the last French capital ship, Jean Bart, commissioned in 1955, displaced about forty thousand tons at full load with two triple turrets of 380-millimetre guns.

All the same, the navy was not incidental to this war. The French navy drew a cordon along the coast of the Mediterranean: sloops and destroyers patrolled day and night, minesweepers cleared the mines laid by the FLN, escort groups intercepted the arms moving in from Morocco, and in 1956 a wide minefield was laid off the Moroccan coast to cut the maritime supply line of North Africa; in September 1958 warships shelled the littoral of Kabylia with their own guns. The FLN built a naval arm of its own, and on 8 December 1958 a mine sank the French light cruiser Georges Philippar at anchor in the port of Algiers.

What really decided the ground war was still the infantry equipment. The French used the MAS-49 self-loading rifle (7.5 by 54 millimetres, ten-round magazine) and the MAS-36 pistol (9 by 19 millimetres), supported by the 12.7-millimetre Hotchkiss machine gun and the 105-millimetre howitzer. On the FLN side the main body of weapons after 1956 was the AK-47 (7.62 by 39 millimetres, thirty-round magazine) supplied from Czechoslovakia, China and Egypt, together with French rifles taken from French stocks; alongside them came French AMX-13 armoured cars, Sherman tanks, the Ouragan propeller-driven fighter, and the Alouette helicopter from 1955.
tactics:
解放陣線用游擊戰對付正規軍，靠的是分散、時間與地形。一支游擊小組通常只有五到十五人，晝夜分開：白天藏在山區的岩窟、林地或廢村裏，夜晚才移動。作戰以埋雷、破壞公路與橋樑、伏擊巡邏隊與哨所、襲擊後立即散開為主；小組在一個地區連續作戰三到七天就轉移，迫使法軍分兵搜索，把兵力攤薄在廣大的空白地圖上。城市裏改用另一套：阿爾及爾的汽車炸彈、狙擊、機關槍掃射與街壘。組織上是一九五八年起確立的半自治區體系，每個自治區有指揮官、屯糧、屯彈藥與救護所，與政治性的特別組織配合，使游擊隊可以在法軍包圍之中長期自給。

法軍的戰術一直在改寫。一九五六年的柵格化把阿爾及利亞切成若干戰區，每區再分小區，每個小區配駐軍、憲兵與特務，重兵死守沿海的那片鹹海，把游擊隊擠向卡比利亞、奧雷斯山與阿特拉斯山區；掃蕩作戰採三段式：先封邊境，再合圍，再由空軍與砲兵覆蓋下逐格清剿。搜索靠直昇機，一九五五年起使用的Alouette是這場戰爭裡第一批用於地面攻擊的直昇機，負責追擊、搜索與轉運。空軍用暴風式與F-84作偵察與封鎖，邊境線上的巡邏晝夜不停。城鎮戰在阿爾比爾打成逐屋逐巷的巷戰：卡斯巴每一個街口都被封死，突擊營沿牆推進，配合砲擊與空襲，到一九五七年十月才肅清。海軍則在外圍維持封鎖、掃雷、護航與對岸砲火支援，把游擊隊的活動範圍壓回內陸高山。
tacticsEn:
The FLN fought the regular army with guerrilla war, and its advantages were dispersion, time and terrain. A guerrilla group numbered usually only five to fifteen men and lived split between day and night: by day hidden in caves, in woodland or in abandoned villages in the hills, moving only after dark. Their methods were laying mines, cutting roads and bridges, ambushing patrols and posts, and breaking off at once after an attack. A group would fight in one area for three to seven days and then move, forcing the French to spread their troops in search and thinning them out across a vast empty map. In the cities a different repertoire was used: car bombs in Algiers, individual sniper shots, machine-gun bursts and street barricades. Organisationally this was the system of semi-autonomous zones set up from 1958, each with a commander, stored food, stored ammunition and a first-aid post, working with the political Special Organisation so that the guerrillas could feed themselves for long periods inside a French cordon.

The French tactics were rewritten again and again. The grid of 1956 cut Algeria into sectors and each sector into sub-sectors, every sub-sector garrisoned with troops, gendarmerie and intelligence officers; the coast, that salted sea, was held fast and the guerrillas were squeezed inland into Kabylia, the Aurès and the Atlas. Sweep operations followed a three-stage form: close the border first, then encircle, then comb the grid under air and artillery cover. Hunting was done from the air with helicopters, and the Alouette, entering service in 1955, was one of the first helicopters ever used in a ground attack role, pursuing, searching and lifting. The air force used the Ouragan and the F-84 for reconnaissance and for sealing the frontier, where patrols never stopped. The fighting in the towns became a war of house by house in Algiers: every street mouth of the Casbah was sealed, the shock battalions advanced along the walls under shellfire and air attack, and the quarter was not cleared until October 1957. Outside, the navy maintained the blockade, swept for mines, escorted convoys and gave fire support to the shore, pressing the guerrillas back into the interior highlands.
data:
時間：起於一九五四年十一月一日，止於一九六二年七月二日，合計七年八個月。

人數：一九五四年十一月一日夜間，解放陣線在約三十座城鎮同時動手，初期有武裝的人數只有數千，其中法國情報估計不足五百名武裝人員可以上戰場。到一九六〇至六一年，法方情報評估武裝分子已增至二十萬至三十萬，其中約十萬人活動在沿海地帶。與此同時，法軍在阿爾及利亞的常駐兵力在高峰時約四十萬，另有約十七萬名當地穆斯林在法軍中服役，多為志願兵。

損失：法方統計法國軍人陣亡一萬七千四百五十六人（其中五千九百六十六人屬意外）至二十三萬一千一百九十六人，傷約六萬至六萬五千人；法方另統計解放陣線陣亡約十五萬二千八百六十三人，其中一萬二千餘人死於自己人的清洗，法國本土另有約四千三百人在所謂咖啡戰中喪生。

裝備與尺度：MAS-49的彈匣是十發，有效射程約三百公尺；AK-47的彈匣是三十發，射擊密度是它的三倍。卡面的鐵甲艦排水約九千噸、鐵甲帶約十一公分、載火砲二十六門；同一年代的法國主力艦讓·巴爾特號滿載約四萬噸，配三八〇公厘主砲；被水雷擊沉的輕巡洋艦喬治·菲利帕爾號排水約七千六百噸。阿爾比爾市區到卡比利亞山區的公路距離約七十公里。

結算：一九六二年四月法國公投有九成一票通過協議；七月一日阿爾及利亞投票，六百五十萬選民中約六百萬人投票，五百九十九萬二千一百一十五票贊成獨立，一萬六千五百三十四票反對。
dataEn:
Time: from 1 November 1954 to 2 July 1962, seven years and eight months in all.

Numbers of men: on the night of 1 November 1954 the FLN struck in about thirty towns at once, and only a few thousand were armed, French intelligence judging that fewer than five hundred of them could be put into the field. By 1960 and 1961 French intelligence assessed the number of fighters at two to three hundred thousand, of whom about a hundred thousand operated in the coastal zone. At the same time the permanent French garrison in Algeria reached about four hundred thousand men at its peak, and about a hundred and seventy thousand Algerian Muslims served in the French army, most of them volunteers.

Losses: French figures put the number of French soldiers killed at between seventeen thousand four hundred and fifty-six (of whom five thousand nine hundred and sixty-six were accidents) and twenty-three thousand one hundred and ninety-six, with about sixty to sixty-five thousand wounded; the same French statistics put FLN deaths at about a hundred and fifty-two thousand eight hundred and sixty-three, of whom more than twelve thousand were killed in their own internal purges, while roughly four thousand three hundred more died in metropolitan France in what was called the cafe war.

Equipment and scale: the magazine of the MAS-49 held ten rounds with an effective range of about three hundred metres, while the AK-47 magazine held thirty rounds, three times its rate of fire. The ironclad on the card displaced about nine thousand tons, carried an iron belt of some eleven centimetres and mounted twenty-six guns; the French capital ship of the same generation, Jean Bart, displaced about forty thousand tons at full load with 380-millimetre guns; the light cruiser Georges Philippar, sunk by a mine, displaced about seven thousand six hundred tons. The road distance from the city of Algiers to the mountains of Kabylia is about seventy kilometres.

The reckoning: in the French referendum of April 1962, ninety-one per cent voted for the agreements; on 1 July the ballot in Algeria was taken by about six million of an electorate of six and a half million, with 5,992,115 votes for independence against 16,534 votes against.
cause:
打起來的原因有四層，疊在一起。

第一層是法國一百三十年的殖民政策與它的法律設定：一八三〇年代征服之後，阿爾及利亞被劃成法國本土的三個省，穆斯林在法律上被要求保留個人身份，卻長期被排除在政治代表之外；一九四七年普查時全境約八百七十萬人，歐裔約一百萬、猶太人口約十萬，剩下的是數百萬穆斯林農民。

第二層是二戰之後的示範效應。突尼斯在一九四七年自治、一九五二年獨立，摩洛哥在一九五三年獨立，鄰國的結果讓阿爾及利亞的民族主義者相信同樣的路走得通；費爾哈特·阿巴斯一九四四年的《阿爾及利亞人民宣言》與一九四六年的宣言，要求的仍然是自治與聯邦。

第三層是一九四五年塞提夫與蓋勒馬的槍聲，以及星月組織自二十年代起在北非鄉村散播的武裝傳統；一九五四年六月九日北非土著軍人殺死一名法國軍官的事件，則讓解放陣線的領導人相信用武裝開路的日子到了。

第四層是決策本身：一九五四年九月二十六日的紅土會議決定用武裝起義代替請願；十一月一日夜，三十餘座城鎮同時開火，解放陣線的武裝——民族解放軍——也在同年取得統一的指揮體系。
causeEn:
There are four layers of cause, stacked one on another.

The first is a hundred and thirty years of French colonial policy and the legal framework built on it. After the conquest of the 1830s Algeria was made into three departments of metropolitan France; Muslims were legally required to keep their personal status, yet they were long excluded from political representation. In the 1947 census the territory held about 8.7 million people, of whom about a million were Europeans and about one hundred thousand Jews, the rest being millions of Muslim peasants.

The second is the demonstration effect after the Second World War. Tunisia gained autonomy in 1947 and independence in 1952, Morocco was independent by 1953, and the neighbouring results convinced Algerian nationalists that the same road was open. Ferhat Abbas, in the Manifesto of the Algerian People of 1944 and the declaration of 1946, was still asking for autonomy and federation.

The third is the gunfire of Sétif and Guelma in 1945 and the armed tradition that the Star and Crescent movement had spread through the North African countryside from the 1920s. The killing of a French officer by North African soldiers on 9 June 1954 convinced the FLN leaders that the day of opening the war by force had come.

The fourth is the decision itself. On 26 September 1954 the meeting in the rue des Telliers decided to replace petitioning with armed insurrection, and on the night of 1 November some thirty towns opened fire at once. The armed wing of the FLN, the National Liberation Army, also acquired a unified command structure in the same year.
impact:
影響分三方面。

對法國，這是一場拆掉第四共和國的戰爭。戰爭的現實、法國本土的反戰運動、一九五八年五月十三日阿爾及爾的兵變與同年六月戴高樂重返巴黎，把第四共和國推到崩潰，換來的是一九五八年十月新憲法與加強的總統制；一九六二年四月的公投則把放棄阿爾及利亞寫成法國人自己的選擇。對軍事的影響同樣深：法國在阿爾及利亞首次把直昇機用於地面攻擊，把空軍與地面部隊的火力協調成一套反游擊程序，這套方法後來被美軍在越南原樣借用；英國軍事史家李德爾·哈特一九五五年提出的革命戰爭理論，以及法國將軍加利埃尼在馬達加斯加的經驗，也在這場戰爭後重新抬頭，游擊戰自此不再被視為正規戰爭的次要變體。

對國際秩序，這是一場示範。阿爾及利亞把非暴力起義加武裝鬥爭加國際化這條路走通了：一九五五年萬隆會議上解放陣線已是與會者，之後亞非會議、不結盟運動與各地的民族主義者都拿它作樣板；蘇聯與中國提供武器與外交掩護，美國則以經濟援助撐住法國，雙方的對抗從一開始就嵌在冷戰裡。

對阿爾及利亞本身，代價與收穫同時到來。一九六二年六月本·貝拉推翻本·赫達出任總理，一九六三年九月又被本·布邁丁取代，之後是土地改革、國有化與大規模的報復清洗；一百萬歐裔居民在一九六二年之後離境，阿爾及利亞與法國的關係斷了數十年。
impactEn:
The effects fall into three sets.

For France this was a war that dismantled the Fourth Republic. The reality on the ground, the anti-war movement at home, the putsch of Algiers on 13 May 1958 and de Gaulle's return to Paris that June pushed the Fourth Republic to collapse, and what replaced it was the new constitution of October 1958 and a strengthened presidency; the referendum of April 1962 then wrote the abandonment of Algeria as a choice made by the French themselves. The military consequences were just as deep: in Algeria France used the helicopter for the first time in a ground attack role and built a counter-guerrilla procedure in which air and ground fire were coordinated, and the United States later borrowed that procedure unchanged in Vietnam. The theory of revolutionary war put forward by the British military historian Liddell Hart in 1955, together with the experience of the French general Gallieni in Madagascar, also came back into fashion after this war, and from then on guerrilla war was no longer treated as a secondary form of regular war.

For the international order this was a demonstration. Algeria made the combination of political rising, armed struggle and internationalisation work: the FLN was already a participant at the Bandung conference of 1955, and afterwards the conferences of Asia and Africa, the Non-Aligned Movement and nationalists everywhere used it as a model. The Soviet Union and China supplied arms and diplomatic cover, while the United States kept France solvent with economic aid; the confrontation was from the outset embedded in the Cold War.

For Algeria itself the cost and the gain arrived together. In June 1962 Ben Bella brought down Ben Khedda and became prime minister; in September 1963 he was in turn overthrown by Houari Boumediene, and what followed was land reform, nationalisation and a large-scale settling of accounts. A million European residents left after 1962, and the tie between Algeria and France was broken for decades.
result:
結果是解放陣線的全面勝利，但勝利的形式不是戰場上的殲滅。

一九五四年到一九五七年，法軍在阿爾比爾、君士坦丁與沿海城鎮取得過明顯的戰術勝利，卡斯巴在一九五七年十月被逐巷清剿肅清；然而一九五八年之後，戰略主動權逐漸轉移：解放陣線轉入城市游擊與半自治區的持久戰，法國本土的反戰聲浪、兵變與戴高樂的自決政策令時間站到解放陣線一邊。一九六〇年十二月十四日聯合國大會通過第一五一四（一五）號決議，一九六一年起解放陣線在紐約的聯合國總部外展開長期政治戰。

談判從一九六一年十月在瑞士埃維昂的馬捷斯蒂克酒店開始，一九六二年三月十八日簽訂《埃維昂協議》：法國承認阿爾及利亞的主權與獨立，換取九十日的過渡期與部分軍隊短期留駐。六月十九日零時停火生效，七月一日最後一批法國外交與軍事人員從阿爾比港登船離開，七月初市政廳降下三色旗；戴高樂在七月三日宣布承認獨立，臨時政府則在七月五日宣告國家成立。

卡面這艘一八六二年鐵甲艦的影子最後留在海上：法國海軍直到一九六七年才撤出梅爾斯凱比爾的基地，而那一帶的艦隊編制早已換成核潛艦與航空母艦——鐵甲帶讓位給反應堆。
resultEn:
The result was a complete victory for the FLN, though not a victory of annihilation on the battlefield.

Between 1954 and 1957 the French army won clear tactical engagements in Algiers, Constantine and the coastal towns, and the Casbah was cleared by street-by-street fighting in October 1957. After 1958, however, the initiative shifted: the FLN turned to urban guerrilla war and to the protracted defence of the semi-autonomous zones, and the anti-war voices at home, the coups and de Gaulle's policy of self-determination put time on the side of the FLN. On 14 December 1960 the United Nations General Assembly adopted Resolution 1514 (XV), and from 1961 the FLN ran a long political campaign outside the United Nations headquarters in New York.

The negotiations opened in October 1961 at the Majestic hotel at Evian in Switzerland, and on 18 March 1962 the Evian Accords were signed: France recognised Algerian sovereignty and independence in exchange for a ninety-day transition and a short-term French military presence. The ceasefire took effect at zero hour on 19 June; on 1 July the last French diplomatic and military personnel boarded ships and left the port of Algiers, and in the first days of July the tricolour was lowered at the city hall. De Gaulle proclaimed his recognition of independence on 3 July, and the provisional government proclaimed the state on 5 July.

The shadow of the 1862 ironclad on the card ended up at sea: the French navy did not leave the base at Mers El Kébir until 1967, and the order of battle there had long since been replaced by nuclear submarines and aircraft carriers. The iron belt gave way to the reactor.
